Want to suggest a guest?
Ajeet Bharti is one of India's most outspoken alternative media voices, known for his sharp political commentary, fearless takes, and unfiltered analysis on Indian politics, media, and the judiciary. With years of experience as a journalist, author, and YouTuber, he brings a rare insider perspective on the country's shifting political landscape, party dynamics, and the narratives shaping public opinion.
In this episode, Vinamre and Ajeet discuss:
• Why BJP came to power in West Bengal and what it means for the state
